blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — First Philippine Holdings Corp. (FPH) has allotted P5 billion to reinstate its common share buyback program, following the management’s assessment that the company’s shares remain significantly undervalued. On Friday, FPH said its board approved the program for the period from Oct. 1, 2026, to Sept. 30, 2028. READ: FPH to continue repurchasing […]...
